items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Joe Rene? Was he in the home or out? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, yeah, he was in that world, too.

ctx.x: That's what I told you about. Near the Vendal.

Oh, yeah. Well, I got up, started to make a solo. Yeah. And there had a light. Let's light that light there. I didn't know nothing about the light, see. And I jumped up, took a solo, and that light went on to me. Yeah. I'd see me fogging going on. I never did that. But I did all right there. I did all good. And I never get a jam session. Some guy was standing outside, so I was playing at a place called The Bookstove. We had about four pieces. So Joe, Joe, Joe Smith and Russell Smith, two brothers. Yeah. Joe said,…
I had to play. I had to play then.
